packagedUI.targetPassScope: Both net-short-edit save sequences completed with page character-multiset, adjacent-page pixel, independent Han glyph geometry and retained-style checks. This does not establish complete typographic quality or preservation of visual containers.
packagedUI.preciseTimeSemantics: Raw first observed returned refinement state, not matched to the current edit revision. May be stale, failed or unavailable; cannot establish current-edit completion or latency. Kept for audit only; final status snapshots and saved-artifact checks are separate.

measurementMethodology.previewObservation: DOM MutationObserver status update, not screen pixel presentation.
measurementMethodology.entryStart: Candidates have already been generated and selected; timing begins immediately before the paragraph-hit click.
measurementMethodology.saveStart: Before clicking Finish Editing; includes edit submission, background preview, waiting for edit mode to close, save-dialog setup, clicking Save and awaiting completion. This is not isolated disk-write time.
measurementMethodology.latencyInterpretation: Observed automated phase timings, not foreground human click latency, visible screen response or pure computation. No estimated automation overhead is subtracted. Each target reloads the renderer page; native-worker and operating-system caches may remain warm.

timingValidity.reason: Preview status observations were not matched to the current edit revision. A later foreground spot check caught stale pre-input completion. The complete run did not preserve status history and cannot be corrected retrospectively; all preview timing fields are retained for audit only, not as current-edit layout or visible-response latency.
timingValidity.saveWorkflowScope: Finish Editing through completed whole-document save, including automation waits and dialog setup.

knownVisualLimitations.description: The original paragraph uses per-glyph TJ spacing. This combined edit spans original physical lines and falls back from local placement preservation to whole-paragraph reflow; nominal spacing cannot reproduce the original first line and yields three lines. The UI uses allowOverflow with fixed growth. The test continued after an overflow warning and completed the edit without invoking resize. The resulting third line exceeds the original text frame by 4.058 pt and extends below the pale dialogue background by 16.598 pt. Reopening infers a new text range from the saved three lines and does not repeat the warning. Character, style and Han-glyph geometry checks do not establish preservation of the original visual container. The current and preceding production outputs are pixel-identical at 2x for each save, so this is not a regression from the weight repair.

sourceLifecycle.methodology: Synthetic one-page PDF registered through the real preload API and inspected by the native worker. This checks renderer lifecycle and handle ownership, not keyboard editing.
checks: 20 same-renderer register/inspect/release cycles succeed without raising the 16-source limit
20 committed reloads reclaim old handles and preserve new-document registration started before app initialization
Same-document hash navigation preserves the current source
A cancelled top-level navigation preserves the current source
Renderer termination reclaims its source before any subsequent navigation
A new renderer can register and inspect immediately after crash recovery

fontCacheAtomicRegression.historicalUIFailureRootCause: Not confirmed: the original intermittent UI failure did not capture the exact unavailable font key. These tests independently reproduce and verify repairs for cache truncation and transient Windows sharing races.

foregroundSpotCheck.metadataAnnotation: Environment description inherited from hidden harness was corrected after the run. Original captured report is preserved byte-for-byte in report-captured.json. No timing, operation, verification or product fingerprint data changed.
foregroundSpotCheck.scope: Activation starts after editable candidates exist; DOM click timestamps separate automation waiting from click-to-state intervals. Input uses the input event; undo/redo additionally capture actual shortcut keydown. Save totals include Done/final reflow/native export/redraw and subsequent whole-document save, not pure disk I/O. Native dialogs are programmatically answered as in the full harness. DOM state observations do not prove screen paint or final-settled precise rendering.
foregroundSpotCheck.environment: Foreground one-target spot check with a fresh application/profile and pre-existing shared disk font cache. Every captured activation, input and save reports document visibility=visible and focus=true. System load and caches differ from the hidden full run; this is not a controlled A/B experiment.
observerLimitations: The old observer captured an old completion before short-insert input: raw -3 ms is invalid and retained. The raw DOM history shows a new 59-character completion at input+5.8 ms.
Spot post-event intervals are derived from DOM history filtered by event time and new character count; they do not measure screen paint.

Precise detection requires pending then returned status, but has no request ID or text-version binding. All seven spot operation returns follow post-event pending and the new matching character-count status. A previously pending request or a later requeued preview can still make this generic observer unsuitable for measuring final-settled layout.

The complete hidden run lacks retained status histories, so its first-completion timings cannot be certified free of old-state contamination or retrospectively corrected; they must not be presented as new-layout or paint performance.
This spot and the complete hidden run differ in window visibility, load and cache state, and are not a controlled A/B comparison.
